todaysEvents.summary: US readies secondary sanctions on Iran trade
todaysEvents.delta: AP reported the US will announce stronger sanctions Monday, including secondary measures on countries trading with Iran; Treasury Secretary Bessent said the rial has never been weaker (AP, Aug 24).
AP reported the rial fell to 2.02 million per dollar at the open, a record low, with IMF forecasting GDP contraction beyond 5% under sanctions and blockade (AP, Aug 24).

todaysEvents.summary: Iran-Oman strait plan in final stages
todaysEvents.delta: AP reported Iran and Oman are in the final stages of a joint-management plan and Oman's foreign minister visits Tehran Tuesday; Iran repeated it wants transit fees before reopening (AP, Aug 24).

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.description: AP reported Iran and Oman are in the final stages of a joint-management plan with Oman's foreign minister visiting Tehran Tuesday, but Iran still conditions reopening on transit fees while Washington readies secondary sanctions. A signed workable deal remains required before Brent moves toward $75-85; Qatar's force majeure still limits LNG availability.

scenarios.label: Stress
scenarios.description: AP reported the US will announce stronger sanctions Monday including secondary measures on countries trading with Iran, and Iran repeated it wants transit fees before fully reopening. Reduced traffic persists under a fee dispute that extends into October; Brent holds $78-95 and JKM stays elevated on Qatar force majeure through mid-September.

scenarios.label: Tail
scenarios.description: Iran's foreign ministry warned any escalation would bring consequences and said its hands are not tied; a breakdown of the Iran-Oman talks or enforcement of the naval blockade could renew full closure and spill into the Red Sea/Bab el-Mandeb. Brent returns to $105-135+/bbl and JKM moves above $30/MMBtu.
